name: Sapphire Reserve
balance_transfer_fee: Either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater
penalty_apr_trigger: Failing to make a Minimum Payment when due, or making a payment that's returned unpaid; can remain in effect indefinitely
pay_over_time_fee: Up to 1.72% per month of the amount selected to pay over time, via Chase Pay Over Time

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $6,000 in purchases in the first 3 months from account opening

verdict.text: Best all-rounder if you use the credits

earn_rates.category: Peloton equipment & accessories (through Dec 2027, up to $5,000 in purchases)

earn_note: Strong bonus categories (dining and direct travel), but the 1× base is weak for uncategorized spend, so a flat-rate earner covers that better.

points.note: Cardmembers who applied before Jun 23, 2025 can redeem points earned before Oct 26, 2025 at 1.5¢ on Chase Travel until Oct 26, 2027; burn those first. Otherwise, transfer for the most value.

transfer_partners.highlight: World of Hyatt is the standout: 1:1, routinely 2–3¢+. Also Aeroplan, Virgin Atlantic, Flying Blue, Singapore. Wyndham added Feb 2026.
transfer_partners.recent_changes: Ten airline partners and four hotel partners, with World of Hyatt at 1:1 the standout.

partners.name: World of Hyatt
partners.notes: CSR keeps the legacy 1:1 rate even after CSP's ratio drops to 4:3 in 2026.

credits.name: Annual Travel Credit
credits.subtitle: auto-applies
credits.description: A flat statement credit against broad travel: airlines, hotels, tolls, parking, transit, rideshare.
tips: The single easiest credit in your whole wallet. It posts automatically against almost anything travel-coded.
Value it at the full $300; it quietly drops the real fee to $495.

credits.name: Apple TV+ & Apple Music
credits.subtitle: through Jun 2027
credits.description: Complimentary Apple TV and Apple Music, worth $324 a year per Chase, through June 22, 2027. Activate by that date. If you already have a paid Apple One subscription, you get an $8/mo discount on it instead. Chase allows one complimentary Apple TV subscription or Apple One discount per Apple Account.
tips: Activate through Chase's app; it doesn't turn on by itself.
Already have Apple One? Activate on Chase.com or the app with the same Apple Account as your Apple One billing to get the $8/mo discount; there's no need to cancel anything.
Android/Spotify household? Set the slider toward $0.

credits.name: The Edit Hotel Credit
credits.subtitle: $250 × 2 · 2-night min
credits.description: Semi-annual credit on ~1,400 luxury hotels via The Edit by Chase Travel. Breakfast for two + $100 property credit; upgrades/late checkout are availability-only (not guaranteed like FHR).
tips: Harder to spend than FHR: two-night minimum, smaller network, and prepaid-rate-only.
Separate from the Chase Travel Hotels Credit below: different hotel list, different booking flow, don't double-count them.
Set the slider to how many 2-night luxe stays you'll actually prepay.

credits.name: Chase Travel Hotels Credit
credits.subtitle: $250 · 2-night min · thru 12/31/26
credits.description: Statement credit through 12/31/26 on stays of 2+ nights booked via Chase Travel at IHG, Montage, Pendry, Omni, Virgin, Minor, and Pan Pacific hotels.
tips: Distinct from The Edit Hotel Credit above: different, more mainstream hotel brands, and it expires 12/31/26 rather than running on The Edit's ongoing schedule.
Confirm on Chase's site whether this has been extended past 12/31/26 before assuming it's gone the following year.

credits.name: Dining Credit
credits.subtitle: $150 × 2 · Exclusive Tables
credits.description: Semi-annual credit, but ONLY at ~400 'Exclusive Tables' restaurants on OpenTable across ~26 cities.
tips: ~400 restaurants vs. Amex Resy's 10,000+. Hard to spend outside major metros or with dietary limits.
Vegas was gutted to one spot in mid-2026; re-check first.
The Exclusive Tables partnership also includes priority access to primetime reservations and special dining events, not just the statement credit.

credits.name: StubHub / viagogo
credits.subtitle: $150 × 2 · enroll
credits.description: Semi-annual credit toward concerts and events.
tips: Enroll, then apply it to an event you'd attend anyway.
Compare against face value; resale markups can erase the 'credit.'

credits.name: DoorDash Promos
credits.subtitle: $35/mo · thru 12/31/29
credits.description: DashPass members get up to $35/mo in DoorDash promos: a $15/mo promo on any qualifying order plus two $10/mo promos on groceries, daily essentials, and more, through Dec 31, 2029.
tips: Use-it-or-lose-it monthly; a grocery or restaurant DoorDash order each month captures it.

credits.name: Lyft Ride Credits
credits.subtitle: $10/mo · thru 9/30/27
credits.description: Up to $10 in monthly in-app Lyft ride credits through Sep 30, 2027, on top of 5× total points on Lyft rides through the same date.
tips: Stacks with the 5× Lyft earn rate; a monthly Lyft ride captures both.

credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS Credit
credits.subtitle: $120 · every 4 years
credits.description: One statement credit up to $120 every four years after the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS application fee is charged to the card (by you or an authorized user). Shown here amortized to an annual figure.
tips: Apply for Global Entry, not just TSA PreCheck; it includes TSA PreCheck and covers the same credit.
Must be paid directly to DHS or an authorized enrollment provider; third-party application services don't qualify.

credits.name: Peloton
credits.subtitle: $10/mo + 10× gear
credits.description: Monthly credit toward a Peloton membership, plus 10× on equipment (up to 50k pts).
tips: Only meaningful if you're a subscriber.

insurance.detail: $500/person · after 6 hrs or an overnight stay

protection_note: Primary rental, real trip-cancellation limits, baggage delay, and emergency evacuation with a dollar limit. The one glaring gap: no cell-phone protection.
rental_note: The CSR includes free primary coverage (up to $75k), paying first, before your own auto policy. Decline the counter's CDW and pay with the card.

status_perks.name: IHG One Rewards Platinum
status_perks.note: Modest: some upgrades and bonus points; IHG elite is among the weakest hotel tiers.

status_perks.name: $75k spend unlocks
status_perks.note: IHG Diamond, World of Hyatt Explorist, Southwest A-List + $500 credit, $250 Shops at Chase. Valuable, but only if you'd spend $75k anyway, and Explorist is the weakest of the four: a 20% point bonus, 2pm checkout, and non-suite upgrades.

status_perks.name: Lounge access
status_perks.note: Chase Sapphire Lounges + Priority Pass: Priority Pass includes 2 guests free. Since Aug 15, 2026 the Sapphire Lounges have shut out Priority Pass and LoungeKey members who got their membership from a non-Chase card, which should have cut the queues. Reserve access is untouched, and the connecting-flight arrival window widens from 3 hours to 5.

services.name: Dedicated customer service team
services.detail: A dedicated Sapphire Reserve customer service line, available 7 days a week, separate from Chase's general card support.

services.name: Reserve Travel Designers
services.detail: Personalized itinerary planning from a dedicated travel design team, valued at up to $300 per trip, a step up from the standard Visa Infinite concierge below.

services.name: Visa Infinite Concierge
services.detail: 24/7 concierge for reservations, tickets, and travel arrangements.

services.name: Visa Infinite Luxury Hotel Collection
services.detail: Elite-like perks (breakfast, upgrades, late checkout, property credit) at 900+ hotels, on top of The Edit.

services.name: Points Boost
services.detail: Up to 2¢/point on select Chase Travel bookings, CSR's redemption edge.

services.name: Visa Infinite travel & roadside
services.detail: Travel & emergency assistance services and roadside dispatch, plus no foreign transaction fees.

services.name: DoorDash DashPass
services.detail: Complimentary 12-month DashPass membership ($0 delivery fees, reduced service fees), a $120 value per Chase, if activated by Dec 31, 2029.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Own Priority Pass Select + Chase Sapphire Lounge access
Covered by Chase's travel & purchase protections

additional_cards.note: After the 2025 refresh, CSR authorized users cost $195 each, a real jump from the old $75. Worth it mainly if a travel companion needs their own lounge access; otherwise the primary can already bring 2 guests into Priority Pass for free.

timeline.text: Legacy 1.5¢ redemption on pre-Oct-2025 points expires; after this, only Points Boost or 1¢ remain.

Chase Sapphire Lounges stopped admitting Priority Pass and LoungeKey members whose membership came from a non-Chase card, so the lounges should be less crowded for Reserve holders. The connecting-flight arrival window also stretched from 3 hours to 5. Nothing changed for Reserve access itself.
Exclusive Tables dining list churned (net +27 restaurants but Las Vegas gutted to one).
New perks activate; the $795 fee (and $195 AU fee) apply at each renewal after this date.
Fee $550 → $795; new credits (Edit $500, dining $300, StubHub $300, Apple, DashPass). Flat 50% travel bonus replaced by Points Boost.
Debuts with a legendary 100k bonus and a $450 fee, the enthusiast benchmark.
